title: Tensor normalization of the coordinate-line counit
statement: For every finite commutative coefficient ring A killed by a positive integer N, every Noetherian scheme B on which N is invertible, and every constructible complex K of finite Tor amplitude, the canonical coordinate-line compact-support projection of [def-pur-coordinate-line-adjunction-maps] is invertible. The actual counit of the composite open/projective adjunction is its inverse followed by K tensor the restricted normalized projective trace and the right unitor: CounitNormalization A N hA B hN hB K.

source.place: First two sentences and final comparison paragraph, expanded coordinate-line calculation

proof.text: Compose the standard open adjunction with the trace-normalized projective-line adjunction. Transport by rightComparison. Expand the composite counit as proper image of the open counit followed by the projective counit.

source.place: Ordinary affine-line composite adjunction and its final site-comparison paragraph

proof.text: The unit-defined open projection followed by tensor of the open counit equals open image of the inverse tensorator followed by the counit: apply Adjunction.projectionMap_app_app_comp_map_counit. Pullback preserves the canonical symmetry. Naturality of the open counit moves this symmetry past the counit and gives the coefficient-first version.

source.place: Ordinary affine-line composite adjunction and its final site-comparison paragraph

proof.text: Expand compact-support projection into proper projection, inverse open projection and pullback compositor. Naturality of the symmetry cancels the compositor against its inverse in rightComparison. Substitute the preceding open identity, then use proper-projection naturality at the open counit. Apply the normalized projective counit equation. The composite trace is exactly integration.

proof.text: Finite-coefficient proper projection is invertible, as are the open projection and the compositor. Take asIso of their canonical composite. Cancel its hom in the preceding equation to obtain the inverse-projection formula. All identities apply to zero coefficients and the empty base.

theorem coordinate_line_counit_tensor
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (B : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian B] (hN : 0 < N) (hB : IsUnit (N : Γ(B, ⊤)))
    (K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A B)
    (_hK : Etale.DerivedCategory.constructibleFiniteTor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) B K) :
    CounitNormalization A N hA B hN hB K
